THIRD-PARTY SOFTWARE DISTRIBUTED WITH BAZEL BUILD VISUALIZER

Bazel Build Visualizer redistributes the runtime components below in its
deploy jar. Artifact coordinates and versions are the exact Bazel-resolved
runtime closure shipped in //app:app_deploy.jar (the runtime closure of its
//app:app binary input). Test and benchmark-only artifacts are excluded.
The adjoining files preserve exact upstream license and notice texts under
collision-safe names; the fat jar's ambiguous generic META-INF legal entries
are not relied upon. APACHE-2.0.txt is the exact unmodified Apache License 2.0
text and is shared only by projects that publish that standard text unchanged.

MAVEN RUNTIME CLOSURE

Aircompressor 2.0.3
  Artifact: io.airlift:aircompressor:2.0.3
  Project: https://github.com/airlift/aircompressor
  License: Apache License 2.0.
  Legal files: AIRCOMPRESSOR-APACHE-2.0.txt, AIRCOMPRESSOR-NOTICE.md

  Snappy-derived Java implementation
    Embedded source in Aircompressor 2.0.3; there is no separate runtime
    artifact or version. Project ancestry: https://github.com/google/snappy
    License: BSD-3-Clause.
    Copyright and license: AIRCOMPRESSOR-NOTICE.md

  Apache Hadoop/Apache Ant-derived BZip2 implementation (version not declared)
    Embedded source in Aircompressor 2.0.3; there is no separate runtime
    artifact. The code entered Aircompressor at commit
    1ec9d30ce2b4041d89f84a045350d117b7a26712 as a fork from Apache Hadoop
    and retains its attribution to Keiron Liddle and Aftex Software for work
    contributed to Apache Ant.
    Projects: https://hadoop.apache.org/ and https://ant.apache.org/
    License: Apache License 2.0.
    License text: AIRCOMPRESSOR-APACHE-2.0.txt

SHADED AND NATIVE COMPONENTS

gRPC Netty Shaded 1.83.1 packages these components under relocated names and
ships their native libraries in META-INF/native/:

  Netty 4.2.15.Final
    Shaded modules cover common, buffer, transport, resolver, codec, HTTP/2,
    proxy/SOCKS, handler and native epoll/unix support.
    Project: https://github.com/netty/netty
    License: Apache License 2.0.
    Legal files: NETTY-APACHE-2.0.txt, NETTY-NOTICE.txt

    The shaded code includes these components identified by Netty's notice;
    except for JCTools, Netty does not declare their embedded versions:

      JSR-166 EG/Doug Lea/Jason T. Greene concurrency code
        Projects: http://gee.cs.oswego.edu/cgi-bin/viewcvs.cgi/jsr166/ and
          http://viewvc.jboss.org/cgi-bin/viewvc.cgi/jbosscache/experimental/jsr166/
        Status: public domain.
        Legal file: NETTY-JSR166Y-LICENSE.txt

      Robert Harder Base64 encoder/decoder
        Project: http://iharder.sourceforge.net/current/java/base64/
        Status: public domain.
        Legal file: NETTY-BASE64-LICENSE.txt

      Webbit-derived WebSocket code
        Project: https://github.com/joewalnes/webbit
        License: BSD.
        Legal file: NETTY-WEBBIT-LICENSE.txt

      SLF4J-derived message formatting code
        Project: https://www.slf4j.org/
        License: MIT.
        Legal file: NETTY-SLF4J-LICENSE.txt

      Apache Harmony-derived networking code
        Project: https://archive.apache.org/dist/harmony/
        License: Apache License 2.0.
        Legal files: NETTY-HARMONY-LICENSE.txt, NETTY-HARMONY-NOTICE.txt

      jbzip2 and libdivsufsort-derived BZip2 code
        Projects: https://code.google.com/p/jbzip2/ and
          https://github.com/y-256/libdivsufsort
        License: MIT.
        Legal files: NETTY-JBZIP2-LICENSE.txt,
          NETTY-LIBDIVSUFSORT-LICENSE.txt

      jfastlz-derived compression code
        Project: https://code.google.com/p/jfastlz/
        License: MIT.
        Legal file: NETTY-JFASTLZ-LICENSE.txt

      Twitter, python-hyper and nghttp2-derived HPACK code
        Projects: https://github.com/twitter/hpack,
          https://github.com/python-hyper/hpack/ and
          https://github.com/nghttp2/nghttp2/
        Licenses: Apache License 2.0 and MIT.
        Legal files: NETTY-HPACK-LICENSE.txt,
          NETTY-HYPER-HPACK-LICENSE.txt, NETTY-NGHTTP2-HPACK-LICENSE.txt

      Apache Commons Lang-derived StringUtil code
        Project: https://commons.apache.org/proper/commons-lang/
        License: Apache License 2.0.
        Legal file: NETTY-COMMONS-LANG-LICENSE.txt

  JCTools Core 4.0.6
    Netty's common module embeds a minimized and relocated JCTools payload;
    there is no separate runtime artifact in the Bazel closure.
    Project: https://github.com/JCTools/JCTools
    License: Apache License 2.0.
    Legal files: GRPC-NETTY-SHADED-JCTOOLS-APACHE-2.0.txt,
      NETTY-JCTOOLS-LICENSE.txt

    NETTY-NOTICE.txt is the exact Netty project-wide notice. The resolved
    shaded jar instead places TCNative's notice at generic META-INF/NOTICE.txt,
